criteria.label: All native domain records and workspace ordering persist across two repositories without backlog files
Linked worktrees share one scope while independent repos and forks remain separate

Whole multi-record command commits or rolls back across processes
Stale revisions reject and exact replay is idempotent while mismatched replay rejects
Illegal scoped record graphs reject without side effects
Busy handling terminates within five seconds with retry feedback
Migration inventories lifecycle, sibling and branch sources with explicit reconciliation
Backup precedes atomic migration activation and source changes abort safely
Updated clients never write legacy files and report later legacy divergence
Normal domain edits change no repo files in clean or already dirty worktrees
All consumers and headless queue agree after worktree removal
Refine applies versioned raw content centrally and rejects stale results
Active GUI and TUI see commits within two seconds with at most one poll per second
Refocus refreshes before writes and concurrent-edit conflicts retain drafts
One deterministic current-state file preserves native/custom/opaque records and excludes machine authorities
